description: Test suite for network interface utilities, including functions for listing external addresses and selecting preferred external interface addresses.

methods.name: listExternalInterfaceAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves non-internal external network interface addresses from a snapshot.

methods.name: pickMatchingExternalInterfaceAddress
methods.description: Selects the preferred external interface address based on given criteria.

methods.name: safeNetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Wraps network interface enumeration with error handling, returning undefined on failure.
